fase5.sql:

FROM academia_membro m
JOIN academia_checkin c ON c.membro_id = m.id
WHERE m.id LIKE '48Z%'

  AND c.data = 20260309;

fase6.sql:
SELECT p.nome, m.id, h.placa
FROM academia_checkin c
JOIN academia_membro m ON m.id = c.membro_id
JOIN pessoa p ON p.id = m.pessoa_id
JOIN habilitacao h ON h.id = p.habilitacao_id
WHERE m.id LIKE '48Z%'
  AND m.plano = 'ouro'
  AND c.data = 20260309
  AND h.placa LIKE '%H42W%';

fase7.sql:
SELECT p.nome, COUNT(*) AS vezes, r.renda_anual
FROM pessoa p
JOIN habilitacao h    ON h.id = p.habilitacao_id
JOIN evento_checkin e ON e.pessoa_id = p.id
JOIN renda r          ON r.cpf = p.cpf
WHERE h.genero = 'feminino'
  AND h.cor_cabelo = 'ruivo'
  AND h.altura_cm BETWEEN 165 AND 170
  AND h.marca_carro = 'Tesla'
  AND h.modelo_carro = 'Model S'
  AND e.nome_evento = 'Congresso de Gestão Hospitalar'
  AND e.data BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20251231
GROUP BY p.nome, r.renda_anual
HAVING COUNT(*) = 3;

c2-f1.sql:
SELECT *
FROM acesso_prontuario
WHERE data = 20260814
  AND acao = 'alterou'
  AND hora BETWEEN 200 AND 359;

c2-f2.sql:
SELECT a.hora, f.nome, f.cargo, pr.codigo, pr.setor
FROM acesso_prontuario a
JOIN funcionario f ON f.id = a.funcionario_id
JOIN prontuario pr ON pr.id = a.prontuario_id
WHERE a.data = 20260814
  AND a.acao = 'alterou'
  AND a.hora BETWEEN 200 AND 359
  AND pr.setor = 'UTI Adulto';

c2-f3.sql:
SELECT f.nome, pl.turno, pl.setor
FROM acesso_prontuario a
JOIN funcionario f ON f.id = a.funcionario_id
JOIN prontuario pr ON pr.id = a.prontuario_id
JOIN plantao pl ON pl.funcionario_id = f.id AND pl.data = a.data
WHERE a.data = 20260814
  AND a.acao = 'alterou'
  AND a.hora BETWEEN 200 AND 359
  AND pr.setor = 'UTI Adulto'
  AND NOT (pl.turno = 'noturno' AND pl.setor = 'UTI Adulto');

c2-f4.sql:
SELECT f.id, f.nome, f.cargo, l.hora
FROM porta_log l
JOIN funcionario f ON f.id = l.funcionario_id
LEFT JOIN plantao pl
       ON pl.funcionario_id = l.funcionario_id
      AND pl.data = l.data
      AND pl.turno = 'noturno'
      AND pl.setor = 'UTI Adulto'
WHERE l.local = 'UTI Adulto'
  AND l.data = 20260814
  AND l.hora BETWEEN 150 AND 220
  AND pl.funcionario_id IS NULL;

c2-f5.sql:
SELECT f.nome, COUNT(DISTINCT l.data) AS noites
FROM porta_log l
JOIN funcionario f ON f.id = l.funcionario_id
LEFT JOIN plantao pl
       ON pl.funcionario_id = l.funcionario_id
      AND pl.data = l.data
      AND pl.turno = 'noturno'
      AND pl.setor = 'UTI Adulto'
WHERE l.local = 'UTI Adulto'
  AND l.hora BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND pl.funcionario_id IS NULL
  AND l.funcionario_id IN (41,55,58)
GROUP BY f.nome
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.data) >= 3;

c3-f1.sql:
SELECT item_id, SUM(quantidade) AS total_saida
FROM movimento_estoque
WHERE tipo = 'saida'
GROUP BY item_id
ORDER BY item_id;

SELECT item_id, SUM(quantidade) AS total_prescrito
FROM receita
GROUP BY item_id
ORDER BY item_id;

c3-f2.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.data, m.hora, c.nome, m.quantidade, m.motivo
FROM movimento_estoque m
JOIN colaborador c ON c.id = m.colaborador_id
WHERE m.tipo = 'saida'
  AND m.item_id = 1
  AND m.receita_id IS NULL;

c3-f3.sql:
SELECT c.nome, COUNT(*) AS ocorrencias,
       SUM(m.quantidade - r.quantidade) AS excesso
FROM movimento_estoque m
JOIN receita r      ON r.id = m.receita_id
JOIN colaborador c  ON c.id = m.colaborador_id
WHERE m.item_id = 1
  AND m.quantidade > r.quantidade
GROUP BY c.nome
ORDER BY excesso DESC;

c3-f4.sql:
SELECT c.nome,
       CASE WHEN m.motivo = 'quebra de ampola' THEN 'justificado'
            ELSE 'sem justificativa' END AS situacao,
       SUM(m.quantidade - r.quantidade) AS excesso
FROM movimento_estoque m
JOIN receita r      ON r.id = m.receita_id
JOIN colaborador c  ON c.id = m.colaborador_id
WHERE m.item_id = 1
  AND m.quantidade > r.quantidade
GROUP BY c.nome, situacao
ORDER BY excesso DESC;

c3-f5.sql:
SELECT c.nome, COUNT(DISTINCT m.data) AS noites,
       SUM(m.quantidade - r.quantidade) AS excesso
FROM movimento_estoque m
JOIN receita r      ON r.id = m.receita_id
JOIN colaborador c  ON c.id = m.colaborador_id
WHERE m.item_id = 1
  AND m.quantidade > r.quantidade
  AND m.motivo <> 'quebra de ampola'
  AND (m.hora >= 2200 OR m.hora <= 459)
GROUP BY c.nome
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.data) >= 5;

c4-f1.sql:
SELECT paciente_id, data_coleta
FROM cultura
WHERE germe = 'Klebsiella pneumoniae'
  AND resultado = 'positivo'
  AND data_coleta BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY data_coleta;

c4-f2.sql:
SELECT c.paciente_id, c.data_coleta, i.setor, i.leito
FROM cultura c
JOIN internacao i
  ON i.paciente_id = c.paciente_id
 and c.data_coleta >= i.data_entrada
 and (i.data_saida IS NULL OR c.data_coleta <= i.data_saida)
WHERE c.germe = 'Klebsiella pneumoniae'
  AND c.resultado = 'positivo'
  AND c.data_coleta BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY c.data_coleta;

c4-f3.sql:
WITH casos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT paciente_id, data_coleta
  FROM cultura
  WHERE germe = 'Klebsiella pneumoniae'
    AND resultado = 'positivo'
    AND data_coleta BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT e.codigo, e.tipo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.paciente_id) AS casos_que_usaram
FROM casos c
JOIN uso_equipamento u
  ON u.paciente_id = c.paciente_id
 and u.data BETWEEN c.data_coleta - 7 AND c.data_coleta
JOIN equipamento e ON e.id = u.equipamento_id
GROUP BY e.codigo, e.tipo
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.paciente_id) = 7
ORDER BY e.codigo;

c4-f4.sql:
WITH casos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT paciente_id
  FROM cultura
  WHERE germe = 'Klebsiella pneumoniae'
    AND resultado = 'positivo'
    AND data_coleta BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT e.codigo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.paciente_id) AS usaram,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.paciente_id IS NOT NULL
                           THEN u.paciente_id END) AS doentes,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.paciente_id IS NOT NULL
                                         THEN u.paciente_id END)
                   / COUNT(DISTINCT u.paciente_id), 1) AS taxa_pct
FROM uso_equipamento u
JOIN equipamento e ON e.id = u.equipamento_id
LEFT JOIN casos c ON c.paciente_id = u.paciente_id
WHERE u.data BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND e.codigo IN ('BI-02', 'BI-07', 'VT-03')
GROUP BY e.codigo
ORDER BY taxa_pct DESC;

c4-f5.sql:
SELECT e.codigo, e.tipo
FROM equipamento e
LEFT JOIN limpeza_equipamento l
  ON l.equipamento_id = e.id
 and l.data BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
WHERE e.codigo IN ('BI-02', 'BI-07', 'VT-03')
GROUP BY e.codigo, e.tipo
HAVING MAX(l.data) IS NULL;

c5-f1.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.lote, p.descricao, c.quantidade,
       c.valor_cobrado,
       p.valor_tabela * c.quantidade AS esperado
FROM cobranca c
JOIN procedimento p ON p.id = c.procedimento_id
WHERE c.valor_cobrado > p.valor_tabela * c.quantidade
ORDER BY c.id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS linhas,
       ROUND(SUM(c.valor_cobrado - p.valor_tabela * c.quantidade), 2) AS excesso
FROM cobranca c
JOIN procedimento p ON p.id = c.procedimento_id
WHERE c.valor_cobrado > p.valor_tabela * c.quantidade;

c5-f2.sql:
SELECT atendimento_id, procedimento_id, COUNT(*) AS vezes
FROM cobranca
GROUP BY atendimento_id, procedimento_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY atendimento_id;

SELECT id, lote, atendimento_id, procedimento_id, valor_cobrado
FROM cobranca
WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT MIN(id)
  FROM cobranca
  GROUP BY atendimento_id, procedimento_id
)
ORDER BY id;

c5-f3.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.lote, c.atendimento_id, c.procedimento_id, c.valor_cobrado
FROM cobranca c
LEFT JOIN execucao e
  ON e.atendimento_id = c.atendimento_id
 and e.procedimento_id = c.procedimento_id
WHERE e.atendimento_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS linhas, SUM(c.valor_cobrado) AS total
FROM cobranca c
LEFT JOIN execucao e
  ON e.atendimento_id = c.atendimento_id
 and e.procedimento_id = c.procedimento_id
WHERE e.atendimento_id IS NULL;

c5-f4.sql:
WITH acima AS (
  SELECT c.lote
  FROM cobranca c
  JOIN procedimento p ON p.id = c.procedimento_id
  WHERE c.valor_cobrado > p.valor_tabela * c.quantidade
),
repetidas AS (
  SELECT lote
  FROM cobranca
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM cobranca
                   GROUP BY atendimento_id, procedimento_id)
),
fantasmas AS (
  SELECT c.lote
  FROM cobranca c
  LEFT JOIN execucao e
    ON e.atendimento_id = c.atendimento_id
   and e.procedimento_id = c.procedimento_id
  WHERE e.atendimento_id IS NULL
)
SELECT lote, COUNT(*) AS erros
FROM (SELECT lote FROM acima
      UNION ALL SELECT lote FROM repetidas
      UNION ALL SELECT lote FROM fantasmas) t
GROUP BY lote
ORDER BY erros DESC;

c5-f5.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.nome
FROM cobranca c
JOIN faturista f ON f.id = c.faturista_id
WHERE c.lote = 'L-0830-C';

c6-f1.sql:
SELECT g.codigo, g.setor, COUNT(*) AS leituras_fora
FROM leitura l
JOIN geladeira g ON g.id = l.geladeira_id
WHERE l.temperatura > 8 OR l.temperatura < 2
GROUP BY g.codigo, g.setor
ORDER BY leituras_fora DESC;

c6-f2.sql:
SELECT codigo, momento, temperatura, anterior
FROM (
  SELECT g.codigo, l.momento, l.temperatura,
         LAG(l.temperatura) OVER (
           PARTITION BY l.geladeira_id ORDER BY l.momento) AS anterior
  FROM leitura l
  JOIN geladeira g ON g.id = l.geladeira_id
) t
WHERE temperatura > 8
  AND (anterior IS NULL OR anterior <= 8)
ORDER BY momento;

c6-f3.sql:
WITH numeradas AS (
  SELECT geladeira_id, momento, temperatura,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY geladeira_id ORDER BY momento) AS n_todas
  FROM leitura
),
fora AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY geladeira_id ORDER BY momento) AS n_fora
  FROM numeradas
  WHERE temperatura > 8
)
SELECT g.codigo,
       MIN(f.momento) AS inicio,
       MAX(f.momento) AS fim,
       COUNT(*) AS leituras,
       MAX(f.momento) - MIN(f.momento) AS duracao
FROM fora f
JOIN geladeira g ON g.id = f.geladeira_id
GROUP BY g.codigo, f.n_todas - f.n_fora
ORDER BY duracao DESC;

c6-f4.sql:
SELECT e.momento, t.nome, e.evento
FROM evento_porta e
JOIN tecnico t ON t.id = e.tecnico_id
JOIN geladeira g ON g.id = e.geladeira_id
WHERE g.codigo = 'G-03'
  AND e.evento = 'abriu'
  AND e.momento BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 02:30:00' - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
                    AND TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 02:30:00'
ORDER BY e.momento;

c6-f5.sql:
SELECT momento, codigo, nome, prox_evento, prox_momento
FROM (
  SELECT e.momento, g.codigo, t.nome, e.evento, e.tecnico_id,
         LEAD(e.evento)     OVER w AS prox_evento,
         LEAD(e.tecnico_id) OVER w AS prox_tecnico,
         LEAD(e.momento)    OVER w AS prox_momento
  FROM evento_porta e
  JOIN geladeira g ON g.id = e.geladeira_id
  JOIN tecnico t   ON t.id = e.tecnico_id
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY e.geladeira_id ORDER BY e.momento)
) x
WHERE evento = 'abriu'
  AND (prox_evento IS DISTINCT FROM 'fechou'
       OR prox_tecnico <> tecnico_id)
ORDER BY momento;

c7-f2.sql:
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf, '.', ''), '-', '') AS cpf_limpo,
       COUNT(*) AS cadastros
FROM cadastro
GROUP BY cpf_limpo
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cpf_limpo;

SELECT UPPER(TRIM(nome)) AS nome_limpo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf, '.', ''), '-', '')) AS pessoas
FROM cadastro
GROUP BY nome_limpo
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf, '.', ''), '-', '')) > 1
ORDER BY nome_limpo;

c7-f3.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(convenio), ''), 'Particular') AS convenio_tratado,
       COUNT(*) AS cadastros
FROM cadastro
GROUP BY convenio_tratado
ORDER BY cadastros DESC;

SELECT a.nome, COUNT(cd.id) AS cadastros
FROM atendente a
LEFT JOIN cadastro cd
  ON cd.cadastrado_por = a.id
 AND cd.cadastrado_em >= DATE '2026-10-01'
 AND cd.cadastrado_em <  DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY a.nome
ORDER BY cadastros DESC;

c7-f4.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cd.convenio), ''), 'Particular') AS convenio_tratado,
       SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.valor, 'R$ ', ''), '.', ''), ',', '.')::numeric) AS total
FROM consulta c
JOIN cadastro cd ON cd.id = c.cadastro_id
GROUP BY convenio_tratado
ORDER BY total DESC;

SELECT c.especialidade, COUNT(*) AS consultas,
       SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.valor, 'R$ ', ''), '.', ''), ',', '.')::numeric) AS total
FROM consulta c
GROUP BY c.especialidade
ORDER BY total DESC;

c7-f5.sql:
WITH limpo AS (
  SELECT id, cadastrado_por,
         REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf, '.', ''), '-', '') AS cpf_limpo
  FROM cadastro
),
original AS (
  SELECT cpf_limpo, MIN(id) AS id_original
  FROM limpo
  GROUP BY cpf_limpo
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
copia AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM limpo l
  JOIN original o ON o.cpf_limpo = l.cpf_limpo
  WHERE l.id <> o.id_original
)
SELECT a.nome, COUNT(*) AS copias
FROM copia c
JOIN atendente a ON a.id = c.cadastrado_por
GROUP BY a.nome
ORDER BY copias DESC;

WITH limpo AS (
  SELECT id, cadastrado_por,
         REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf, '.', ''), '-', '') AS cpf_limpo
  FROM cadastro
),
original AS (
  SELECT cpf_limpo, MIN(id) AS id_original
  FROM limpo
  GROUP BY cpf_limpo
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
copia AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM limpo l
  JOIN original o ON o.cpf_limpo = l.cpf_limpo
  WHERE l.id <> o.id_original
)
SELECT a.nome, COUNT(*) AS consultas,
       SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(con.valor, 'R$ ', ''), '.', ''), ',', '.')::numeric) AS valor
FROM copia c
JOIN consulta con ON con.cadastro_id = c.id
JOIN atendente a ON a.id = c.cadastrado_por
GROUP BY a.nome
ORDER BY valor DESC;

c8-f1.sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(inicio, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, COUNT(*) AS plantoes
FROM hora_extra
GROUP BY mes
ORDER BY mes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT profissional_id) AS pessoas
FROM hora_extra
WHERE inicio >= '2026-09-01'
  AND inicio <  '2026-10-01';

c8-f2.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM inicio) AS dow,
       CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM inicio)
         WHEN 0 THEN 'domingo'
         WHEN 1 THEN 'segunda'
         WHEN 2 THEN 'terça'
         WHEN 3 THEN 'quarta'
         WHEN 4 THEN 'quinta'
         WHEN 5 THEN 'sexta'
         WHEN 6 THEN 'sábado'
       END AS dia,
       COUNT(*) AS plantoes
FROM hora_extra
WHERE inicio >= '2026-09-01'
  AND inicio <  '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY dow, dia
ORDER BY dow;

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM inicio) AS hora, COUNT(*) AS plantoes
FROM hora_extra
WHERE inicio >= '2026-09-01'
  AND inicio <  '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY hora
ORDER BY hora;

c8-f3.sql:
SELECT p.nome,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM h.fim - h.inicio)) / 3600, 1) AS horas,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM h.fim - h.inicio)) / 3600 * p.valor_hora * 1.5, 2) AS valor
FROM hora_extra h
JOIN profissional p ON p.id = h.profissional_id
WHERE h.inicio >= '2026-09-01' AND h.inicio < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY p.nome, p.valor_hora
ORDER BY horas DESC
LIMIT 5;

c8-f4.sql:
WITH setembro AS (
  SELECT p.nome,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM h.fim - h.inicio)) / 3600 AS horas
  FROM hora_extra h
  JOIN profissional p ON p.id = h.profissional_id
  WHERE h.inicio >= '2026-09-01' AND h.inicio < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY p.nome
)
SELECT nome,
       ROUND(horas, 1) AS horas,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY horas DESC) AS posicao,
       ROUND(100 * horas / SUM(horas) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM setembro
ORDER BY posicao;

WITH setembro AS (
  SELECT p.nome,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM h.fim - h.inicio)) / 3600 AS horas
  FROM hora_extra h

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.nome AS setor, c.qtd * m.valor_unit AS valor
  FROM opme_consumo c
  JOIN opme_material m ON m.codigo = c.material
  JOIN opme_setor s ON s.cc = c.cc
)
SELECT COALESCE(setor, 'TOTAL') AS setor, SUM(valor) AS valor
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (setor)
ORDER BY GROUPING(setor), valor DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.nome AS setor,
         to_char(c.lancado_em, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
         c.qtd * m.valor_unit AS valor
  FROM opme_consumo c
  JOIN opme_material m ON m.codigo = c.material
  JOIN opme_setor s ON s.cc = c.cc
)
SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(setor) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL GERAL' ELSE setor END AS setor,
       CASE WHEN GROUPING(mes) = 1 THEN 'subtotal' ELSE mes END AS mes,
       SUM(valor) AS valor
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (setor, mes)
ORDER BY GROUPING(setor), setor, GROUPING(mes), mes;

         data - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY login, turno ORDER BY data)::int AS grupo

       SUM(c.qtd) AS stents,
       SUM(c.qtd * m.valor_unit) AS valor,
       MIN(c.lancado_em::date) AS primeiro_dia,
       MAX(c.lancado_em::date) AS ultimo_dia
